apps.name: Reynard
apps.subtitle: Gecko-based browser, a real WebKit alternative
apps.localizedDescription: Reynard is an experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13 and up, rendering pages with the same engine Firefox uses instead of Safari's WebKit. It is actively developed and published from the project's own GitHub releases.
apps.versionDescription:
Reynard 0.17.0 | Reynard

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.16.0...0.17.0

### Improvements
- The native text input integration has been rewritten from scratch, so typing now feels truly native, supports nearly all iOS text editing behaviors, and is significantly more stable.

### New Features
- The address bar now automatically focuses for input on new tab pages when using a physical keyboard.
- You can now cycle between tabs using the Ctrl + Tab and Shift + Ctrl + Tab keyboard shortcuts.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where a tab would appear blank after closing another tab in the tab overview.
- Fixed an issue where dragging the iPad floating keyboard or shortcut bar would push the web view upward.
- Fixed an issue where taps would sometimes land in the wrong spot on some iframe elements when the scroll to hide toolbar is enabled.
- Fixed several UI issues.

### Engine

Updated Gecko to [157.0.1](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_157_0_1_RELEASE) (released Oct 6, 2026).
